from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np,json
from pathlib import Path
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
r=Robot()
root=Path('/app/output')
obs=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
count=0
history=[]
def state(): return np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'])
def save(label):
 global count
 count+=1
 obs.save(root/f'{count:03d}_{label}')
 np.savez(root/'current.npz',p=state(),**{c:obs.last[c] for c in obs.last})
 (root/'current_meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(obs.meta))
 print('SAVED',count,label,'eef',state()[26:29], 'q',state()[4:11],flush=True)
def move(q=None,steps=40,grip=1,base=None,torso=0,label='move'):
 global obs
 p=state(); start=p[4:11]; q=start if q is None else np.array(q)
 a=np.zeros((steps,13)); a[:,:7]=np.linspace(start,q,steps); a[:,7]=grip;a[:,12]=-1
 if base is not None: a[:,8:11]=base;a[:,12]=1
 a[:,11]=torso
 np.save(root/f'action_{len(history):03d}.npy',a);history.append(a.tolist())
 obs=r.submit('joint_position',a,include_depth=True,video='none')
 save(label)
def point(cam,u,v):
 c=obs.meta['cameras'][cam];K=np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']);T=np.array(c['cam2world_gl']);d=obs.depth[cam];d=d[-1] if d.ndim==3 else d
 z=float(d[v,u]);p=np.array([(u-K[0,2])*z/K[0,0],-(v-K[1,2])*z/K[1,1],-z,1]);return (T@p)[:3]
def fk(q):
 origins=[([0,0,.333],0),([0,0,0],-np.pi/2),([0,-.316,0],np.pi/2),([.0825,0,0],np.pi/2),([-.0825,.384,0],-np.pi/2),([0,0,0],np.pi/2),([.088,0,0],np.pi/2)]
 T=np.eye(4)
 for qi,(p,rx) in zip(q,origins):
  A=np.eye(4);A[:3,3]=p;A[:3,:3]=Rot.from_euler('x',rx).as_matrix()@Rot.from_euler('z',qi).as_matrix();T=T@A
 return T
save('start')
